name: Planet Fighter Transfer and Citadel Read Regression
description: Ownership, capacity, atomic fighter accounting, and treasury visibility for planetary APIs.

tests.name: Create owner
Create visitor
Create corporate officer
Fixture planet and citadel

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, population, colonists_unassigned, fighters, citadel_level) VALUES (977701, 1, 'Fighter Transfer QA', @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'player', 'M', 1, @{admin_player_id}, 0, 0, 50, 1) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type='player', fighters=50, citadel_level=1;

tests.name: Fixture citadel defenses and treasury

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, treasury, owner_id, construction_status, target_level, construction_start_time, construction_end_time, planetaryShields, militaryReactionLevel, qCannonSector, qCannonAtmosphere) VALUES (977701, 1, 555, @{planet_fighter_owner_player_id}, 'idle', 0, 0, 0, 100, 1, 50, 40) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1, treasury=555, construction_status='idle', target_level=0, construction_start_time=0, construction_end_time=0, planetaryShields=100, militaryReactionLevel=1, qCannonSector=50, qCannonAtmosphere=40;

tests.name: Set owner location

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Land owner ship and set fighters

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE, fighters=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Fixture enslaved population with existing assignments

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET population=1000, population_type='SLAVE', colonists_unassigned=400, colonists_ore=300, colonists_org=200, colonists_eq=100, colonists_weapons=0 WHERE planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Prepare exact harvested stocks and a five-hold ship

data.sql: DELETE FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Set harvest ship capacity

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ore=0, organics=0, equipment=0, holds=5 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Create harvest commodity capacity rows

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES (977701,'ORE',0,100000,0),(977701,'ORG',0,100000,0),(977701,'EQU',0,100000,0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET max_capacity=100000;

tests.name: Create accumulated harvest inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES ('planet',977701,'ORE',2,0),('planet',977701,'ORG',3,0),('planet',977701,'EQU',4,0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: Harvest transfers only stock that fits without turns
Harvest state conserves all goods and syncs ship cargo

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='ORE')=0 AND (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='ORG')=0 AND (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977701 AND commodity_code='EQU')=4 AND s.ore=2 AND s.organics=3 AND s.equipment=0 FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.ship_id=s.ship_id WHERE pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Owner sees current citadel state, defenses, and treasury
Owner overview includes treasury without management internals
Transfer fighters from ship to planet
Transfer fighters from planet to ship
Reject zero quantity
Capacity refusal preserves fighter counts

data.sql: UPDATE ships s SET fighters=st.maxfighters FROM shiptypes st WHERE s.type_id=st.shiptypes_id AND s.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Reject transfer above ship capacity
Assert capacity refusal did not change fighter counts

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=st.maxfighters FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id JOIN shiptypes st ON st.shiptypes_id=s.type_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Set source fighters to zero

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Reject transfer exceeding available ship fighters
Assert insufficient-source rejection preserved quantities

data.sql: SELECT p.fighters=70 AND s.fighters=0 FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Set visitor location

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1, lastplanet=977701 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id};

tests.name: Land visitor ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=TRUE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id});

tests.name: Landed visitor does not receive treasury balance
Landed visitor overview omits treasury and ownership data
Unauthorized visitor cannot emancipate
Owner emancipates the whole population without cost
Emancipation preserves assigned and unassigned counts

data.sql: SELECT population=1000 AND population_type='COLONIST' AND colonists_unassigned=400 AND colonists_ore=300 AND colonists_org=200 AND colonists_eq=100 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977701;

tests.name: Create emancipation QA corporation

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations(corporation_id,name,owner_id,tag) VALUES (977703,'Emancipation QA Corporation',@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id},'EQA') ON CONFLICT (corporation_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Create Leader, Officer, and Member roles for emancipation

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) VALUES (977703,@{planet_emancipate_officer_player_id},'Officer'),(977703,@{planet_fighter_visitor_player_id},'Member') ON CONFLICT (corporation_id,player_id) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role;

tests.name: Create slave populations owned by the corporation

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,type,created_by,population,population_type,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq) VALUES (977703,1,'Corp Emancipation QA',977703,'corp','M',1,@{admin_player_id},400,'SLAVE',100,100,100,100),(977704,1,'Officer Emancipation QA',977703,'corp','M',1,@{admin_player_id},300,'SLAVE',75,75,75,75),(977705,1,'Rollback Emancipation QA',977703,'corp','M',1,@{admin_player_id},200,'SLAVE',50,50,50,50) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='corp',population=EXCLUDED.population,population_type='SLAVE',colonists_unassigned=EXCLUDED.colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore=EXCLUDED.colonists_ore,colonists_org=EXCLUDED.colonists_org,colonists_eq=EXCLUDED.colonists_eq;

tests.name: Corporation Member cannot emancipate a corporation planet
Member refusal leaves population and allocations unchanged

data.sql: SELECT population=400 AND population_type='SLAVE' AND colonists_unassigned=100 AND colonists_ore=100 AND colonists_org=100 AND colonists_eq=100 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977703;

tests.name: Corporation Officer emancipates all slaves without cost
Corporation Leader emancipates a separate colony
Corporation emancipation preserves population and every allocation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=400 AND population_type='COLONIST' AND colonists_unassigned=100 AND colonists_ore=100 AND colonists_org=100 AND colonists_eq=100 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977703) AND (SELECT population=300 AND population_type='COLONIST' AND colonists_unassigned=75 AND colonists_ore=75 AND colonists_org=75 AND colonists_eq=75 FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977704);

tests.name: Create injected failure for emancipation after row update

data.sql: CREATE FUNCTION v3_qa_fail_emancipation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF OLD.planet_id=977705 AND OLD.population_type='SLAVE' AND NEW.population_type='COLONIST' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'injected emancipation rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$;

tests.name: Install AFTER UPDATE failure trigger for emancipation

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_qa_fail_emancipation AFTER UPDATE OF population_type ON planets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_qa_fail_emancipation();

tests.name: Injected failure refuses emancipation instead of partially committing
Emancipation rollback preserves type, population, and allocations

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN population=200 AND population_type='SLAVE' AND colonists_unassigned=50 AND colonists_ore=50 AND colonists_org=50 AND colonists_eq=50 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977705;

tests.name: Remove emancipation rollback trigger

data.sql: DROP TRIGGER v3_qa_fail_emancipation ON planets;

tests.name: Remove emancipation rollback function

data.sql: DROP FUNCTION v3_qa_fail_emancipation();

tests.name: Prepare evil-aligned landed player and SLV cargo

data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment=(SELECT min_align FROM alignment_band WHERE is_evil=TRUE ORDER BY min_align LIMIT 1),lastplanet=977702,sector_id=1 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Load slave cargo and land at destination

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,onplanet=TRUE,holds=10 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Fixture ship slave cargo

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'SLV',2 FROM players WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} ON CONFLICT (ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=2;

tests.name: Evil player deposits slaves as slave population
Slave delivery consumes cargo and does not mix population

data.sql: SELECT p.population=2 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=2 AND COALESCE(sc.quantity,0)=0 FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id} LEFT JOIN ship_cargo sc ON sc.ship_id=pl.ship_id AND sc.commodity_code='SLV' WHERE p.planet_id=977702;

tests.name: Restore fixture alignment

data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment=0 WHERE player_id=@{planet_fighter_owner_player_id};
